title: REPORT on the housing crisis in the European Union with the aim of proposing solutions for decent, sustainable and affordable housing
part_text: Text as a whole without the words: ‘urges competent public authorities to mobilise publicly owned land, review land zoning regulations and reclassify infrastructure-ready land for immediate development, to fast-track the delivery of affordable housing and cooperative, social and non-profit models; highlights that any land-use strategy must balance housing needs with high-quality construction standards;’ and ‘including the development of public infrastructure, to ensure social cohesion and prevent socio-economic segregation and market-distorting practices;’
part_context: Urges efforts to improve the availability of building land in a sustainable manner,
